Yu Quan, the Chinese pop duo.

Hearing “Cool to the End” for the first time left an indelible mark on my childhood; I thought it was a masterpiece.

It opened my eyes, and I made a clean break with my parents’ generation of pop.

No more “Into a New Era,” “Come Home Often,” “Happy Old Home,” “Wishing You Peace” or “365 Blessings” for me.
